# The Mustard Seed (Matthew 17:20)

## Emotional Focus
Even tiny faith grows into something big.

## Key KJV
“If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed… nothing shall be impossible unto you.” (Matthew 17:20)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus said faith as small as a mustard seed can move mountains. God makes tiny faith grow into something strong and beautiful.

## Coloring Prompt
A tiny mustard seed growing into a big tree with birds in the branches.

## Read-along flow + response
“Even a little faith in Jesus grows big.”
